children.name: Xeronema callistemon W.R.B.Oliv.
children.description: Xeronema callistemon is a species of flowering plant endemic to the Poor Knights Islands and Taranga Island in the north of New Zealand.

children.name: Xeronema moorei Brongn. & Gris
children.description: An endemic rhizomatous perennial herb of New Caledonia, the type species of the genus Xeronema, with a scattered but wide distribution across Grande Terre. It grows in open, rocky shrubland and maquis on ultramafic or volcano-sedimentary substrates at roughly 400-1,600 m, typically on narrow ridges, stony flats and rock fissures. Like its New Zealand relative X. callistemon it produces large one-sided 'bottlebrush' flower spikes with red flowers and prominent stamens.
